audit.why: HARD 8/10 fits: Wind Wall blocks TF's Q AND his card-autos (both projectiles), the tldr's 'walk the card inside the wall's edge' advice is accurate, and TF's out is the map, not the duel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full phases[].side had Yasuo on all 7 rows; content win[] and the packet levelChart give Skill at level 3, levels 4-5, and 2+ items.
audit.why: Level 3 onward the lane hinges on Wind Wall timing (25s CD vs 4s uptime) — a baited wall is a full trade window, which is a skill test, not a Yasuo default. Late, TF's pick/split utility offsets his teamfight scaling.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3 and 6 moved to Skill with whys rewritten to match; rows 0,1,4,5 already agreed and were left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits despite Wind Wall's cooldown being THE tempo of this lane; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Wind Wall: 25/23/21/19/17s, blocks projectiles 4s. Yasuo Q: 4s base. Gold card is an attack projectile — walled unless delivered inside the wall. Passive shield + E-Q weave is why melee-range card cycling loses.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to cooldowns; both bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles with kit-grounded content.

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W gold card for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — 25s at rank 1, 17s max, blocks projectiles for 4s: hold Q and card-autos until it's spent. - His Q cycles every 4s; dodge the third, knocked-up one. Budget gold card for his engage, R for the map.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Wild Cards fly farther than anything he has — throw from the wave's edge so a reactive Wind Wall wastes only one rotation.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: His passive shield plus E-Q weave wins any melee-range exchange — one dash through minions and your card cycle never finishes.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: level 3 turns on his wall timing — dodge and punish a mistimed Wind Wall and the trade is suddenly yours.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay even when you space well — bait the 25-second Wind Wall, then poke through the downtime.

edits.before: Late TF is a coin with two good sides: split the side lane R-safe, or hold Destiny as the pick-and-collapse button.
edits.after: Late is even: his windwall and knockup-R scale, but your R-safe split and pick threat keep the map playing scared.
